radii.source: radii: NAIF pck00011.tpc (IAU WGCCRE 2015); mean radius: JPL planetary/satellite physical parameters

complex.ref: g = 36.5 cm/s^2; simple-to-complex transition D_t = 39.7 g^-0.4 km (g in cm/s^2; icy-body fit of Aponte-Hernandez et al. 2021, PSJ 2:235, as stated in Bottke et al. 2024, PSJ, eq. 3), g = GM / R^2 from the JPL satellite physical parameters (solar-system.md 2.3); complex fresh depth d = 0.366 D^0.559 km (Schenk 1989, JGR 94:3813, the Rhea fit as reproduced in Stern, Porter & Zangari 2015, arXiv:1412.1405, eqs. 3-6; Cassini complex slopes 0.49-0.59 on Rhea, Iapetus and Mimas, White & Schenk 2011, LPSC 42 #2283); blended from D_t to 2 D_t

calibration.ref: NASA NSSDC fact sheet geometric albedo (solar-system.md 2.5)

procedural.ref: disc-integrated colour B-V 0.69, V-R 0.57 (Karkoschka 2001, Icarus 151:51, table VIII (HST)); tint = relative reflectance (R, V, B) as linear sRGB (R, G, B): rho_B/rho_V = 10^(-0.4 ((B-V) - (B-V)sun)), rho_R/rho_V = 10^(0.4 ((V-R) - (V-R)sun)), or without V-R the B-V slope continued linearly in wavelength (B 440, V 550, R 640 nm: rho_R/rho_V = (rho_V/rho_B)^(90/110)); (B-V)sun 0.65, (V-R)sun 0.53 (Johnson, as Karkoschka 2001); brightening of fresh crater interiors and ejecta
